title: Making fuel cakes when the rains arrive
odia:
କାଳକ ଯାକ ଥିଲା ବସି
ଆଷାଢ଼ ମାସରେ ପାରୁଛି ଘସି।
literal_meaning: Idle all that time, now laying out dung cakes in Ashadha.
meaning_odia: ସୁବିଧାର ସମୟରେ କାମ ନକରି ବସି ରହିବା, ଆଉ ଅନୁକୂଳ ସମୟ ଗଲା ପରେ କାମ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା। ଶୁଖିବା ଦରକାର ଥିବା ଘସିକୁ ବର୍ଷା ମାସରେ ପାରିବାର ଚିତ୍ରରେ କାମ ପକାଇ ରଖିବାର ଅସୁବିଧା ଧରାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The source gloss identifies a person who keeps putting work off. The image makes the cost of delay concrete: fuel cakes need to dry, but their preparation has been postponed until the rains. Beginning at last does not recover the favourable conditions already lost.
usage_example: Someone leaves an outdoor repair untouched through dry weather and starts only when repeated rain makes the job difficult. A neighbour recalls the saying. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ଘସି are dried dung cakes used as fuel. Setting their preparation against Ashadha gives the verse its seasonal irony: the task depends on drying, yet the long-idle worker begins in a rainy period.

witnesses.locator: Page10, two lines beginning କାଳକ ଯାକ ଥିଲା ବସି.
witnesses.note: Upload prints ଆସାଢ଼ and ପରୁଚି; these differ from displayed public-witness ଆଷାଢ଼ and ପାରୁଛି. Uploaded line break retained.
Supplies adopted lexical wording including ଆଷାଢ଼ and ପାରୁଛି; explicit gloss labels procrastination.

graphic.alt: A woman arranges round fuel cakes on wet ground while looking up at dark clouds and falling rain.
graphic.caption: An imagined late start meets the rains before the fuel cakes can dry.

odia_summary: ସମୟ ଥିଲାବେଳେ ବସି ରହି ଅସୁବିଧା ବେଳେ କାମ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା।
english_summary: Delay turns a manageable task into a badly timed one.
